overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong, specialized social media presence across academic and professional platforms (LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon) with a total audience of 3,580 followers. His content consistently focuses on computational social science, coordinated inauthentic behavior, tool releases, and academic recruitment, achieving healthy engagement across all platforms.

contentThemes.description: Sharing newly published papers, grants awarded, and research findings on coordinated inauthentic behavior.
Updates on analytical tools developed by the team, such as CooRnet v2.0.
Hiring posts for postdoctoral researchers and PhD opportunities in computational social science.
Discussions on methodological approaches to studying cross-platform disinformation and conference presentations.

recommendations: Increase posting frequency on Bluesky to capitalize on high interaction rates (reposts and likes).
Tailor recruitment posts with visual media or direct links to job descriptions on LinkedIn to convert high impression numbers into direct applications.
Cross-promote major research breakthroughs and software releases across all platforms simultaneously using visual assets or summary infographics.

platformInsights.bluesky: Yields the highest overall engagement rate, driven by a highly active academic network that heavily reposts research announcements and student opportunities.
platformInsights.mastodon: Provides steady niche engagement on specialized technical updates like CooRnet releases and methodological discussions among decentralized web users.
platformInsights.linkedin: Commands the largest follower base (1,850 followers) and yields the highest absolute engagement numbers for major career milestones and research grants.

topPerformingContent.content: Just published our new paper on coordinated inauthentic behavior on social media platforms!
New research opportunity for PhD students interested in computational social science. Reply for details!
Excited to announce that our research team has been awarded a new grant to study information operations across social media platforms.
